Fantech ATOM 104 MK886 V2 Sumi Edition Mechanical Gaming Keyboard - Grey (Red Switch)

Dominate the battlefield with lightning-fast tactile precision and sleek aesthetics using the Fantech ATOM 104 MK886 V2 Sumi Edition Mechanical Gaming Keyboard. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium full-size hardware component is masterfully engineered for pro-grade esports competitors, intense PC gamers, and custom desktop builders across Egypt who demand swift execution and reliable daily hardware performance. Housed in a striking dual-tone grey frame, it stands as the definitive choice for a clean and responsive battle station layout upgrade.

The ATOM 104 MK886 V2 features high-performance Mechanical Red Switches, providing a fluid, linear, and remarkably quiet keystroke layout environment optimized for rapid double-tapping and silent click operations. Boasting a standard full 104-key layout configuration, it offers 25-key anti-ghosting rollover tracking structures to register every single macro with total accuracy. Dynamic RGB backlighting illumination patterns flow beneath the double-injection keycaps, protecting your setup environment while enhancing nocturnal viewing specs.
